system_accounts.sys:start: Creates a new character's starting cash and the bank's welcome deposit.
system_accounts.sys:founding: Creates the bank vault and the shop tills when the town begins.
system_accounts.sys:residents: What residents spend at the player's market stall (residents have no accounts until CITY-004).
system_accounts.sys:fees: Takes late fees and stall rent out of the economy.

day.note: Accounts are settled for each game day that has ended, at midnight.

loan.note: Simple interest: total = principal + principal x rate x term. Paid in equal daily instalments from the current account at each day's end, the first at the end of the day after the loan is taken; the last instalment takes what is left.

stock.note: Each resident's shop visit (a stay doing one of visit_acts) buys one item the shop sells, chosen by a fixed hash of the resident, the day and the shop.

price.note: factor = 1 + slope x (target - stock) / target, kept between min and max; price = usual price x factor, in whole chips. The shop pays sell_share of its current price for what it buys.

reputation.note: A shop's prices to the player move with the best reputation the player has with anyone who works there.

stall.note: Rent is paid for the game day it is taken. A resident who comes to the market while the stall is open looks at each item set out; they buy one with chance buy_bp x (usual price / price)^elasticity, at most 95%, decided by a fixed hash. Prices may be set from 1 chip up to max_price_factor x the usual price.

new_in_town.title: New in town
new_in_town.summary: Settle in: meet your neighbour, open a bank account, and do her a small favour.

meet.log: Your new neighbour Mei works at the Tram Café on Market Square. Go and say hello.

hello.say: {greeting}! You must be {player}, from across the courtyard. I'm Mei. Welcome to Linden!

options.text: Hello. Is it always this busy?

busy.say: Only when the tram's in! You'll get used to it. Have you sorted yourself out yet? Money and all that?

options.text: Not yet. Where do I start?

money.say: Open an account at Linden Bank first. Nobody here pays in cash, and the bank gives newcomers a little something to start. Then... could I ask a favour?

favour.say: I'm stuck here until close and there's no bread at home. Could you bring me a loaf from a grocer? Market Grocer is just behind the square.

options.text: Bank first, then bread. Leave it to me.

bank.log: Open an account at Linden Bank, on Linden's north side. Go inside and press B at the counter.

bread.log: Buy a loaf of bread at a grocer. Inside a shop, press B.

back.say: You're back! Did you find a loaf?

options.text: Here you are. Call it a welcome present.
Here. That'll be the price on the shelf, please.
About that... I ate it on the way.

gift.say: Oh, that's kind! Then the next coffee's on me. And I'll tell everyone at the café about you.

paid.say: Of course! Here you go. A head for business already, I see.

ate.say: You ate my bread? Well. At least you're honest. I'll manage.

gift.log: You gave Mei the bread. She won't forget it.

paid.log: Mei paid you for the bread.

ate.log: You ate Mei's bread. She'll manage.

errand_runner.title: Errand runner
errand_runner.summary: Abe the courier has too many parcels and not enough legs.

offer.line: You look like you're in a hurry too.

o1.say: Always! Three rounds and one pair of legs. Say... you're new, aren't you? Want to earn a few brix?

o2.say: A parcel's waiting at Market Grocer. It goes to Jai at the Old Town Museum, and only Jai. Bring me word when it's done and I'll pay you.

pickup.log: Collect Abe's parcel from Market Grocer, by the fountain behind Market Square.

deliver.log: Take the parcel to Jai at the Old Town Museum. Only Jai.

d1.say: {greeting}. Is that... a parcel for me? I've been waiting all week.

options.text: It might be. What's in it?

d2.say: Wonderful. Tell Abe he's got a fast new runner.

d3.say: A first edition, for the museum. Worth more than this building's roof. Please, it's ours.

options.text: I think I'll hold on to it.

report.log: Tell Abe the parcel reached Jai.

options.text: Yes, and I could do more of these.

r2.say: Good work. Here's your pay. Couriers around town will have rounds for you now, if you want them.

r3.say: Ha! Keen. Here's your pay. Ask any courier for a round; I'll put the word out.

delivered.log: You delivered Abe's parcel. Couriers now offer you rounds.

kept.log: You kept the museum's rare book. Abe and Jai will not forget.

night_gardener.title: The night gardener
night_gardener.summary: Someone has been planting flowers round the fountain at night. Olu at Market Grocer wants to know who.

offer.line: Any idea who's planting those flowers?

o1.say: None! Every morning there's a new row round the fountain behind the shop. If you're up late, have a look for me?

watch.log: Look round the fountain behind Market Grocer between 21:00 and 05:00. Press ] to speed the clock.

who.log: Fresh earth, and a trowel marked "H." Hari tends the Tram Court garden. Ask him about it.

w2.say: Ah. Yes. The council cut the flower money this year, so... I plant them at night, with my own seeds. Don't tell anyone?

options.text: Let me help you plant the next row.
Olu asked me to find out. I'll have to tell him.

w3.say: Thank you. Here, take some seeds. Sell them, plant them, whatever you like.

w4.say: Really? Then come by the garden any day. There's always weeding, and I'll pay you for it.

w5.say: I see. Well. Do what you must.

tell.log: Tell Olu at Market Grocer who the night gardener is.

t1.say: Well? Did you find out who it is?

options.text: It's Hari, from the Tram Court garden.

t2.say: Hari! The quiet one! Here, for your trouble. I owe you a good story.

kept.log: You kept Hari's secret. He gave you seeds.

helped.log: You offered to help Hari. Gardeners now offer you work.

told.log: You told Olu about Hari. Olu paid you for the news.

own_stall.title: A stall of your own
own_stall.summary: Eli at the square's grocer thinks you could sell at the market.

offer.line: How does a market stall work here?

o1.say: You rent one by the day, fifteen brix, right here on the square. Buy cheap, sell dear, and the market crowd does the rest.

o2.say: Sensible. Put it by in a savings account at the bank; it grows a little every day. Come and rent a stall once you've the money.

o3.say: Linden Bank lends to anyone with an account. Just mind you pay it back on time; they're not forgiving.

funds.log: Get together 15 Bx for a day's rent: save it, or borrow it at Linden Bank.

rent.log: Rent a stall on Market Square: stand on the square and press B.

sell.log: Set out items on your stall (B on the square) and sell three of them to the market crowd.

report.log: Tell Eli how your first day went.

r1.say: There's the new trader! How did it go?

options.text: Sold out! Thanks for the tip. Let me buy you lunch.
Not bad. I'm keeping every chip, mind.

r2.say: Ha! I won't say no. Come by any time; for you, the regulars' price.

r3.say: Fair enough. That's how you get rich, I suppose.

shared.log: You stood Eli lunch. Market Grocer now gives you the regulars' price.

solo.log: Your first market day is done. The stall is yours to rent any day.

lines.busy: You've already got a job on. Finish that first!
lines.thanks: Lovely, thank you! Here's what I owe you, and a bit extra.
